decisive_items: regular atrial tachycardia at cycle length 320ms
variable PR intervals indicating AV dissociation
response.rationale: The acute decline in ejection fraction to 10% in the setting of dual tachycardia and prior amiodarone use most directly supports tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy as the active process driving decompensation, whereas heart failure describes the syndrome rather than the specific cause.

rejected.why: Only lists one of two tachycardias and does not account for EF drop
Represents the baseline structural disease, not the acute decline or arrhythmia mechanism
Describes symptoms and signs but lacks etiologic specificity
Only prior amiodarone exposure; no thyrotoxicosis evidence
No infiltrative cardiomyopathy features beyond low EF
